Hi Elena — thanks for the spec. Appreciate the clarity on retention and seats.

Summary of what I think will meet Atlas' ask:
- Tracing: 90-day high-fidelity retention (10% sampling) — Pro tracing SKU, billed per million spans with a target effective rate after sampling.
- Logs/metrics: 180-day retention tier, rolled into the Observability Storage bucket (per-GB / month).
- Dashboards: 2 Advanced Dashboard seats (real-time alerts, historical comparisons).

Short answer on credits: for a 12-month reserved commit at the Dedicated tier we can offer a blended credit that offsets up to ~20% of observability charges in year 1 (applied as monthly usage credits). I want to flag that this is compressible depending on committed GPU throughput and token spend — credits are tradeable against the hosting commitment.

I attached a simple counterproposal workbook with two pricing paths (monthly vs 12mo commit) and an example crediting schedule. Please review and tell me which path you prefer; I can escalate to Pricing for a firm concession if needed.

Next step: if this looks directionally correct, could you confirm anticipated average monthly spans and GB ingested? That will let me give the exact per-month numbers.

Team — forwarding Atlas' procurement asks. Key asks: 1) a QoQ growth cap guarantee (<=10% QoQ for add-ons) and 2) a fixed credit floor if usage spikes beyond commit (example: if >30% overage, apply an emergency buffer credit to limit month-over-month bill impact). They want refundable vs non-refundable line items called out.

Proposed go-to:
- Approve a 12-month Dedicated commit with a 18% blended credit in year 1 (slightly below my 20% ask) if they commit to the minimum GPU throughput (we already have a preliminary usage baseline).
- Provide an overage protection clause: for overages up to 30% we'll bill at committed rates; beyond 30% we apply a 50% mitigation credit on the delta for one month as a one-time buffer (not recurring).
- Refundable elements: first-month platform activation fee is refundable only within 30 days if they cancel; committed credits are non-refundable but applied monthly.

Ask: can we approve the 18% blended credit + the one-month emergency buffer (50% mitigation on delta >30%)? If approved I'll send a formal counter and include the refundable/non-refundable language.

Elena — appreciate the patience. Following internal alignment, please find our formal counter below: summary first, full details in the attached workbook.

Summary (12-month Dedicated commit):
- Blended observability credit: 18% off observability add-on charges in year 1, applied as monthly usage credits.
- Overage protection: for months where actual ingest/spans exceed committed baseline by more than 30%, Redwood will apply a one-time mitigation credit equal to 50% of the dollar value of the delta above 30% for that month only. This mitigation is limited to one occurrence per 12-month contract term.
- Refundable vs non-refundable: platform activation fee (first month) refundable within 30 days of activation; committed credits are non-refundable but applied monthly.
- Operational pre-reqs: signed minimum GPU throughput appendix and executed SOW within 14 days of counter acceptance; billing automation will be configured to show credit line items monthly.

Attached: RDW-3249-counterproposal-20260521.xlsx (detailed line-items, monthly examples for 45M spans / 6TB ingest).
